format: Animated documentary: AI-animated scenes + self-rendered post graphics + motion graphics; clean real footage only when watermark-free primaries exist
editing: Real source clips with original dialogue, concise reaction commentary between clips, varied footage, no repeated looping race footage or long static cards.
music: Choose a restrained documentary soundtrack from the approved style palette; duck under original and narrator speech. Current N3on edit: original dark piano-like synth + mysterious ambient + minimal electronic; no hip-hop kick/snare/hi-hat groove.
style: Research-driven stories, dry humor, immediate concrete hook, no filler or fake quotes.
latest_feedback: User called the 55-second Ranked With Friends video perfect. Preserve the format, but allow more original speaker dialogue in future videos.
ending: Resolve the story, then a specific short audience question. Current: Would you still play it, or does Kai have a point?
opening: Begin with an authentic source reaction and let the speaker finish the thought. Never cut mid-sentence merely to meet a 1–3 second hook target. N3on current opening lasts 6.32 seconds, source 36.70–43.02.
original_dialogue: Let speakers finish meaningful thoughts and reactions. Increase the original-dialogue share compared with Ranked With Friends (about 6.9 of 55 seconds). Do not pad runtime or duplicate the same claim in narration. No fixed percentage mandated by user.
captions: Large heavy white captions only, fixed position: 52 px at 720x1280, 5 px black outline and extra 1 px fill, maximum two lines. Do not add attention-grabbing text elsewhere.
length_strategy: Editorial recommendation (not a proven revenue optimum): start at 45–59 seconds where the story fits, never pad. Test shorter or longer with meaningful story and cleared rights. See RESEARCH_CAPTIONS_AND_REVENUE.md; recheck date-sensitive YouTube policies.
on_screen_text: Captions for spoken lines (old style) PLUS punch words at hook/turns. Still forbidden: quote cards, source/date footers, credit labels, badges, separate question overlays.
publication_metadata: Every new episode must include final accurate English title.txt, description.txt and matching upload_metadata.json with source links, no placeholders or unsupported clickbait. User uploads manually; no automatic publishing.
file_layout: TWO REPOS: youtubeshortskai contains all pipeline code, agent instructions, registry, titles, descriptions, captions, source manifests and narration. youtube2026 contains ONLY final numbered MP4 videos directly in root, no README, metadata, scripts or subfolders.
titles: Lead with concrete context and a meaningful audience question. Explain who/what the video is about and why the viewer should care; not vague What do you think? titles and not unsupported clickbait.
source_gate: Reject watermarked re-uploads and fan edits; speaker's own channels or clean VODs only; otherwise animate.
hook_rule: Consequence first; WHO/WHAT/Why in plain language by second 5.
